title: pm-dispatch SKILL: retire the mandatory shift-end SKILL-suggestion list — narrow the channel to three report classes, default zero (maintainer ruling 2026-08-12)
body:
Filed by the skills seat (session `session_012Gg6rMAti8ZaueWb6BRsDn`), 2026-08-12, executing a maintainer ruling from the seat 专题 chat.

## Provenance (maintainer, verbatim, untranslated)

> 还有各车道下班时会提交 skills 建议有必要吗?就是那些搞得后来skills越来越乱。

> 同意

(Approving the seat's recommendation: the mandatory per-shift suggestion list was the growth engine that fattened the skill text — every shift institutionally produced prose candidates. The structural locks against bloat now exist — shrink-only ratchet, ID-lint, ADR-class human merge, single skills seat — so the fix targets the producer side.)

## The deltas

1. **Retire the fixed deliverable**: the seat-exit checklist item "final report includes this tenure's SKILL update-suggestion list (查重后立单)" is removed. A shift with zero suggestions is a good shift; suggestion production is no longer a duty.
2. **Narrow the channel to three report classes, default zero** — anything a departing seat reports must be one of:
   - ① **a principle that is wrong or missing** (invariant-level, rare) → to the skills seat via the 专题 channel;
   - ② **a mechanizable item** (propose a gate or script — ⛔ never prose) → a normal card;
   - ③ **a platform-fact change** (one row of a `references/` fact table).
3. **"Lessons learned" prose is no longer admissible** into skill texts — under the principles-only regime, error-prevention lives in gates and judgment lives in the model tier; narrative lessons were the old world's compensation mechanism.
4. Reports arrive as `finding`-class items in the skills lane; this seat triages; the default disposition for anything outside the three classes is close (not planned).

## Landing notes

- Edits the seat-exit checklist (in `references/seat-post-protocol.md`) and the corresponding principle line in `SKILL.md`. ⚠️ Ratchet headroom 0 — offsets in-PR (this delta is net-negative, which helps).
- Rides the closing consolidated batch (carrier #7945) as its third member — one subagent, one PR.
- Dispatch `model: claude-fable-5` (mandatory clause). ADR-class: draft PR, human merge.
